dataset_name: SOC-QA Intelligence Synthetic Analyst Activity Stress Test
description: Randomized synthetic SOC analyst workflow records for analyst-activity ingestion, PM4Py process discovery, and playbook-conformance testing.
notes: Synthetic data only; no real users, hosts, or incidents.
Events are globally timestamp-sorted and interleaved across cases; use case_id to reconstruct traces.
Contains conformant sequences and deliberate skip, reorder, repeat, and unexpected-activity deviations.
Ground-truth labels are not embedded in event records to avoid contaminating ingestion or model inputs.
Optional escalation/remediation steps appear in a subset of cases.
